description: Interval MDP with a controller choice at s0 (A interval vs B point) plus interval nature.
provenance: Exact by enumeration of controller actions x extremal nature. A: pess 0.3 / opt 0.5; B: 0.4 point. Controller maximizes => pess max(0.3,0.4)=0.4 (pick B), opt max(0.5,0.4)=0.5 (pick A). Matches IntervalMDP.jl robust max-reach.

measured.note: Live peer runs, 2026-06-27 (see TOOL_COMPARISONS.md). PRISM has no interval-MDP support.
